architecture: Repository enhancement retaining the pure team reducer, UI adapter, embedded media, source content and deterministic Python single-file build. No framework, API or CDN dependency.
priorityOutcomes: Removed every legacy individual/local-player game session, route, progression/achievement flow, timer, result screen and unsupported event handler. Removed five obsolete suites and obsolete solo cases; runner explicitly enumerates supported multiplayer suites.

Preserved BOARD → QUESTION → REVEAL → one of exactly three award actions → BOARD/MATCH_COMPLETE, with token validation, idempotent linked score transactions, deterministic turn advance and atomic Undo.

Restoration reconciles scoring formulas, transaction/history/helper identities, board slot identity, completion/winner metadata and monotonic serial high-watermarks, preventing corrupted saves from generating duplicate transaction IDs.
Authentic V2 historical scoring fixtures and known owner-reviewed editorial records remain recoverable without upgrading them to source-checked status.
Already observed queued storage events after reload are ignored; genuinely different saves still lock the stale host. Failed persistence keeps the live match and offers host backups.

variants: visual (eligible images preferred, explicit text fallback)

validated backups and owner editorial import/export

remainingLimitations: No physical Samsung, iPhone or tablet testing. Playwright viewport/touch emulation covers portrait/landscape and explicit device pixel ratios; it does not prove real Safari, virtual keyboard or hardware behavior.

WebKit could not launch because seven system shared libraries are unavailable; privileged dependency installation was unavailable. Chromium and Firefox executed. Managed Chromium blocks file:// navigation; actual Firefox file:// offline startup and scoring succeeded.

Automated axe reports zero violations in the clean run, but contrast evaluation is incomplete for some gradient/illustration elements; see the detailed accessibility report rather than interpreting it as complete contrast certification.
All720 questions were structurally audited, not all individually fact-checked anew.88pending and5disputed records remain for owner review and are excluded from new matches.

Visual matches can use an explicitly announced text fallback when an eligible image is unavailable in a requested category/value. No commercial recordings, audio-identification bank, silhouette/crop/comparison engine or other untested optional media formats were added.

The owner library is a local host tool, not server authentication or encryption. Anyone holding the HTML/host backup can inspect embedded answers. Advanced structured items can be edited through validated JSON import/export; the basic mobile editor preserves their metadata.

Storage denial cannot guarantee persistence across browser closure; the live memory state remains playable with visible manual backup guidance. Browser file and hosted origins may have independent local storage.
